name: Marina
summary: Per-slip cost is driven by slip length/vessel class, dock system (timber vs. concrete floats, steel vs. concrete piles), utilities (power, water, fire suppression, pump-out) and exposure (wave attenuation). Site-specific heavy items — dredging, breakwaters, bulkheads, fuel systems — vary by orders of magnitude and are carried as separate line items. Evidence is a set of recent public project budgets (USFWS Boating Infrastructure Grant FY2025-26 summaries, Treasure Island, Berkeley); these are total project costs for transient facilities, so the default is medium confidence.

typicalSize.method: Public examples: Treasure Island rebuild 168 slips (e9); Berkeley Marina has 1,000 slips overall but rebuilds dock-by-dock (e10); BIG transient projects 10-66 slips. Mid 150 = typical small/medium recreational marina (judgment).

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Common marina planning ratio of ~0.5-0.75 parking spaces per slip (judgment; local zoning governs).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Per-slip total project cost from public budgets (our arithmetic, total / slips): Georgetown SC $26.6k (e4, replacement docks + pedestals), Old Point Comfort VA $53.0k (e5), Ashley Marina SC $61.6k (e3, incl. welcome building), New Rochelle NY $75.0k (e1), Bayfield WI $78.3k (e8), Clayton NY $78.9k (e2, incl. services building), Conneaut OH $100.4k (e6, 26-100 ft slips), Treasure Island CA $148.8k (e9), Bristol PA $175.3k (e7). Median $78.3k is a total project cost for mostly large transient slips; x ~0.85 hard-cost share = ~$66k, rounded down to $60k for an average 30-40 ft recreational slip. Low = Georgetown (replacement on existing basin); high = Treasure Island-type full rebuild (~$150k). Dredging, breakwater, bulkhead and fuel are line items, not in this baseline.

scope.notes: Baseline per slip = floating dock system (main walk + fingers), piles, share of gangway/abutment, utility pedestals (power + water), dock electrical distribution, fire suppression standpipes, lighting, security gate and a modest landside share (parking, walks). Excludes dredging, breakwater/wave attenuation, bulkhead/seawall, fuel dock, boater-services building (see line items), land/submerged land lease, permits and design.

qualityTiers.method: Economy = low/mid (27k/60k = 0.45, raised to 0.6 since the low case reused existing infrastructure). Premium = concrete floats, wider fingers, 50A/100A power (~$90k). Luxury = high/mid (150k/60k = 2.5): mega-yacht / exposed sites (Bristol PA $175k, Treasure Island $149k).

systemSplit.method: No public elemental breakdown found. Derived: marine construction (35: floats, piles, gangway, abutment) ~48%; dock electrical/pedestals/lighting (26) ~15% (Berkeley scope lists 'code compliant utilities such as electrical, potable water and fire suppression', e10); potable water (22) 5%; fire suppression (21) 3%; demolition of old docks (02) 3%; landside concrete/abutment (03) 3%; signage/dock boxes (10) 2%; landside paving/landscape (32) 5%; site utilities (33) 4%; earthwork/shore slope protection (31) 2%; marine mobilization/general conditions (01) 10%. Verify against a bid schedule of values.

lineItems.name: Utility pedestals (power + water, lighting) per slip

cost.method: One pedestal typically serves two slips (qty 0.5 per slip). Queen City Marina pairs 12 new pedestals with 21 berths (e11). Installed $/pedestal incl. feeders is estimating judgment; higher for 100A/3-phase large-vessel service.

lineItems.notes: Carve-out of the baseline per-slip cost.

lineItems.name: ADA gangway (80-120 ft aluminum) with abutment and landing float

cost.method: Gangways appear in BIG scopes (Westport '80-by-5-foot gangway', e12; New Rochelle 'a new gangway', e1) but are not priced separately. Range is estimating judgment; ADA slope rules drive length with tidal range.

lineItems.notes: Carve-out; one per dock access point.

lineItems.name: Side-tie / transient floating dock with utilities (per LF)

cost.method: Total project cost / LF of side-tie dock (our arithmetic): Meigs St Pier renovation $996/LF (e16), Willoughby VA $1,392/LF (e13), Skull Creek SC $1,566/LF incl. fuel and gangway (e14), Reefpoint WI $1,802/LF (e15), Herreshoff RI $2,196/LF (e17), Ann St Pier fixed pier extension $4,719/LF (e17). Mid ~ median of floating-dock cases; high = fixed pier extension.

lineItems.notes: Use for linear dockage not counted as slips; enter LF as qty.

lineItems.name: Bulkhead / seawall replacement (per LF)

cost.method: Queen City Marina NJ: inner and outer bulkhead replacement along 500 ft plus 12 pedestals and protection system, total $1,000,675 = ~$2,000/LF (e11). Single data point; low/high +/- for vinyl/steel sheet vs. concrete/king-pile walls and soil conditions (judgment).

lineItems.notes: Enter LF of new or replaced bulkhead.

lineItems.name: Basin / channel dredging incl. disposal (per CY)

cost.method: No authoritative unit price found in this session. Range is estimating judgment for small-marina mechanical/hydraulic dredging: low = clean sand with nearby open-water or beneficial-use placement; high = contaminated sediment requiring upland dewatering and landfill. Mobilization ($150k-$500k) often dominates small jobs — verify with a dredging contractor.

lineItems.notes: Corpus Christi T-Head project combined dock replacement with basin dredging ($19.4M total, e18).

cost.method: Guntersville State Park wave break protecting a 300-ft dock and 12-slip dock: $1,042,750 total (e19). Exposed coastal rubble-mound breakwaters run far higher (judgment for high).

lineItems.name: Fuel dock: USTs/ASTs, piping, dispensers, containment

cost.method: Naples City Dock UST replacement (diesel + ethanol-free gasoline) total $624,580 (e20) sets the mid; low/high for small AST systems vs. new fuel dock with float and multiple dispensers (judgment).

lineItems.name: Sewage pump-out station (fixed) incl. piping to sanitary

cost.method: Estimating judgment; in-slip pump-out systems (as at Seaport Marine, e21) cost more. Often grant-funded under the Clean Vessel Act.

lineItems.notes: Usually required by permit for marinas with overnight berthing.

lineItems.name: Boater services building (restrooms, showers, laundry, office)

cost.method: Clayton NY and Ashley Marina SC BIG scopes include such buildings (e2, e3) but are not priced separately. $/SF is estimating judgment for small wet-core buildings.

lineItems.notes: Division set to 01 as a whole-building allowance.

pctOfHard.method: Marine work carries heavy permitting (USACE, state coastal agency, water quality; e.g., Berkeley lists BCDC, USACE and RWQCB permits, e10), environmental studies, marine engineering and inspection. Judgment: 15-30% of hard cost, mid 22%.

softCosts.notes: Long lead times for floats/piles (Berkeley cites 'very long lead time for the procurement of specialized material', e10) — consider escalation to procurement date.

hard.method: Berkeley Marina Docks D & E carried a 10% construction contingency on the base bid (e10); 8-15% typical for marine work.

perPrimaryUnit.method: BIG/Treasure Island all-in per-slip totals span ~$27k-$175k (e1-e9); max allows for full rebuild with soft costs and contingency. Dredging/breakwater-heavy projects can exceed this.

openQuestions: BIG totals are project costs for transient (mostly 26 ft+) facilities; a few private-marina or municipal bid tabs with slip counts and slip-length mix would firm up the recreational baseline.
Berkeley Docks D & E slip count would turn e10 into a per-slip data point.
Dredging $/CY, pump-out, pedestal and gangway unit costs are estimating judgment — need sourced unit prices (state DOT/USACE bid abstracts).
